name: Nádudvar (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Nádudvar: a blue shield with a white crane, reeds and a green base, with a helm, an arm-and-sabre crest and red, blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nádudvar arms with helm, crest and mantling
